# 楞嚴經義疏注經科

**ID:** X0265
**Volume:** X10
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 宋 子璿述
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0265

## Contributors
- 子璿 (A000085)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle (1卷) **sectional-outline** (*kē* 科) accompanying [子璿](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%90%E7%92%BF)'s ten-fascicle *Yìshū zhùjīng* 義疏注經 ([KR6j0673](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0673), T39 no. 1799) — the Northern-Sòng Huáyán-Chán commentary on the *Śūraṃgamasūtra*. The *kē* genre is a Sòng-Yuán Buddhist exegetical apparatus consisting solely of a hierarchical sectional outline (*fēnkē* 分科) of the parent commentary, providing the topical "skeleton" by which the commentary's argument can be read at a glance. It is the pedagogical complement to the running prose commentary, used in lecture-room teaching and private study.

The opening of the text exhibits the standard *kē* layout: "Explanation of the sūtra is divided into two: 1. The title (*Dàfódǐng…*); 2. The body of the text (divided into three: 1. Preface section; 2. Main section; 3. Transmission section)" (釋經分(二)：一題目(大佛)；二本文(三)：一序說分(二) …). The structure recapitulates Zǐxuán's analytical hierarchy across the entire *Yìshū* and is the textual precursor to the more elaborate Míng-period *kē* outlines (e.g., [KR6j0681](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0681) of [真鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E9%91%91) for the *Zhèngmài shū*, and [KR6j0686](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0686) of [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85)).

**Abstract**

Authorship is securely attributed to **Chángshuǐ Zǐxuán** 長水子璿 by the colophon (長水沙門子璿述) and by the obvious correspondence of the outline to the parent *Yìshū* commentary. Composition is bracketed at **1024 – 1038** — the productive period of Zǐxuán's *Yìshū* and his death year. The work is preserved as **X10 no. 265** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.
